steps.en: In Claude Code, add its marketplace, install the plugin and reload plugins
steps.zh: 在 Claude Code 里添加它的插件市场、安装插件并重载

steps.en: Work as usual: debug, fix, correct the agent when it gets something wrong
steps.zh: 照常干活：排错、修复，agent 做错时纠正它

steps.en: Counts tool calls; the turn past 50 ends by launching a background reflector on the redacted transcript
steps.zh: 数工具调用；过 50 次的那轮结束时，用脱敏会话片段在后台起反思会话

steps.en: Reflector stages create/patch/merge intents; the promoter validates each and atomically writes the skill
steps.zh: 反思会话只提交新建／修补／合并提案；提交器逐条校验后原子写入技能

steps.en: Archives skills unused through probation, then injects an index of its skills and the last run's result
steps.zh: 归档试用期内从没被用过的技能，再注入自有技能索引和上一轮结果

value.en: Lessons from your fixes and corrections become skills that get patched, merged and pruned on their own — you stop hand-writing and gardening the skills folder
value.zh: 你修过的坑、纠正过的做法自动变成技能，并自己修补、合并、淘汰——你不用再手写和打理技能目录

sources: README 'Install' (/plugin marketplace add tigerless-labs/autoharness; /plugin install autoharness@autoharness; /reload-plugins)
README 'Configuration' (AUTOHARNESS_REFLECT_EVERY_N default 50 tool calls; CONSOLIDATE_EVERY_N 250; maturity/capacity defaults)
README 'Walkthrough' steps 1-7 (.claude/skills/<name>/ layout, ledger, session-start index, archive to .claude/skills/.archive/)
src/autoharness/hook/dispatch.py, on_stop.py, spawn.py (tool-call counter, detached claude -p --agent autoharness:reflector)
src/autoharness/hook/capture.py (raw transcript byte slice, 200 KB window, redaction)
src/autoharness/hook/on_session_start.py + lib/lifecycle.py (archive zero-use-and-zero-view after probation, recall index injection)
agents/reflector.md (model: haiku; tools Read, Grep, Glob, stage_skill)
